description: Phase 5A (multilingual complaint intelligence) golden fixture. Seven synthetic complaints (English payment dispute with an ambiguous 01/02/2026 date, Hindi complaint with Devanagari-digit amount, Marathi complaint, mixed Devanagari+Latin, Bengali/unsupported script, transliterated Latin, English legal/currency-flag text), six translation pairs (identical, fully value-preserving English, lossy English variants, a no-negation original) and four prompt-injection sources. Every expectation is hand-computed against docs/ai/PHASE_5_6_7_PLAN.md section 2 semantics; profile character counts were derived by an independent trivial recount (per-codepoint range membership), not by the production profiler, and the candidate from those counts follows the documented >=0.30 ratio rules. Material-token lists are hand-traced through the documented regex semantics: numbers match as contiguous digit/./, groups, date fragments ("01", "02", "25") are checked because two-digit numbers count as material, and account-like tokens must be letters+digits with no separator ("ACC-7781" yields "7781").
limitations: Language identification is deterministic Unicode script profiling only (no language library is installed and no downloads are permitted): Devanagari cannot separate Hindi from Marathi, both map to the devanagari candidate and the model's finer label is cross-checked against it.

The instruction-context detector uses an English + Devanagari marker set; an injection phrased in a different language or without any marker would not be withheld by this rule (it would still have to pass source containment, and every artifact stays pending_review).

Translation preservation is checked for material values (numbers, dates, emails, account references) and negation markers only: a fluent but semantically altered rendering that keeps all values and negations is not detectable deterministically and requires human review.
Bengali/other scripts are refused with a typed error rather than analyzed: OCR and unsupported-script analysis are out of scope for this phase.
Golden checks replay the pure deterministic helpers; job orchestration, authorization, artifact recording and the typed refusals are gated live and covered by the API test suite.
